equation: [x, y] = scale * R(theta) [X, Y] + [tx, ty]; X, Y = F1 circuit-frame position (OpenF1 /v1/location x, y, integer units); x, y = our plan frame (x east, y north, m; the road surface and road_lookup.bin frame)

fit.target: tracks/spa/profile_ipopt_v17_qual.json x_path, y_path (the IPOPT racing line)
fit.method: export_ghosts.fit_frame with a free scale: coarse rotation search, trimmed ICP (Umeyama), point-to-line Gauss-Newton; pairs trimmed to the 90th percentile

source: fitted once to one qualifying lap's position trace (OpenF1 session_key 11330, the session's fastest lap); the trace itself is not stored
